scripts.worker: cd services/worker-py && uv run python -m worker
scripts.bench: cd services/worker-py && uv run python bench.py
scripts.format: biome format --write . && cargo fmt --all && cd services/worker-py && uv run ruff format
scripts.check:ts: biome ci . && pnpm typecheck:fast && pnpm test
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
scripts.check:py: cd services/worker-py && uv sync --locked && uv run ruff format --check && uv run ruff check && pyright && uv run pytest -q
scripts.check: pnpm check:ts && pnpm check:rust && pnpm check:py && pnpm check:licenses && pnpm eval --fake-llm && pnpm e2e
